info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to thunder, to roar, to make a loud sound

entries.artha_hindi: GaRwA yA paSu ke samAna Sabda karanA
GaRwA yA paSu ke samAna Sabda karanA

examples: pronnanAda ca siMhavat' (hari॰2.61.47). proccErjagarjetyarTaH. unnanAdeti pAWAntaram.
'yayO surARAM pUtanogratejAH samunnadantI yuDi siMhanAdAn' (hari0 3.53.62). uccEH samaM nadantItyAha.
'tataH sa tezAM rudatAM mahAtmanAM BuvaM ca KaM cAnu vinAdayansvanaH' (rA0 2.103.40). sutamAM pratiDvanayannityarTaH.
'vinadya ca guhAM vIro GorAM mAyAmayIM nfpa' (hari0 2.84.48). vinadya nAdavatIM kftvA.
'naBaSca pfTivIM cEva tumulo (GozaH) vyanunAdayan' (gItA 1.19). vyanunAdayan nAdena pUrayan.
'sUtAH paramasaMskArA mAgaDAScottamaSrutAH. gAyakAH stutiSIlASca ninadantaH pfTak pfTak' (rA0 2.65.3). uccErvyAharanta ityarTaH.
'anye'ntarikze'Byanadan GarmAnta iva toyadAH' (BA0 saBA0 127.148). aByanadan AkroSan, uccErAkrandan.
'niSamya taM (ninAdaM) pratyanadaMstu kOravAH' (BA0 droRa0 109.37). pratyanadan pratiGozamakurvan.
'gamBIraM pratinadyeva ninAdaM nadato giriH' (rAja0 4.285). gamBIraM pratinadya kftaM nAdamuddiSya gaBIraM naditvA.
